description: The specified basis recognizer for enumeration index \(r\) and candidate program \(e\) searches codes \(\langle d,\langle s,t\rangle\rangle\) in order. It returns zero at the first triple for which \(d\) is valid, \(d\in W_{r,s}\), and \(\operatorname{Match}(e,d,t)\); it diverges if no triple succeeds.
